_about: Where each model named in the network spec actually runs. 'map' reroutes a spec model; 'fallback' serves any model that is neither routed nor installed. Free OpenRouter model IDs change often: check https://openrouter.ai/models?q=free and edit.

local.description: Everything on this laptop through Ollama. No internet needed.

openrouter.description: Each department on a different free OpenRouter model. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY and internet.

hybrid.description: Departments run locally; only the Farm Director uses a large free cloud model.

local-api-test.description: Tests the cloud code path against local Ollama's OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
